name: MeowChan is an imageboard media downloader for 4chan and 8kun.
Written by Tomka (tfgrass), formerly known as themirage.
Update checking is disabled by MEOWCHAN_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=1 for this installation.
Opens your browser. MeowChan does not download or install updates.
Checks GitHub at most once every 24 hours, sending only the MeowChan version as User-Agent; no IDs or telemetry.
